Weakening, renaming away, or deleting an entry here is not a way to pass CI: the key set is derived from REQUIRED|PROTECTED in lean_lint.py. BSM.cgmyTemperedRate.pin: def cgmyTemperedRate (C Y : ℝ) : ℝ := 2 * C * |Real.Gamma (-Y) * Real.cos (Real.pi * Y / 2)|

BSM.cgmyTruncatedExponent.pin: noncomputable def cgmyTruncatedExponent (C G M Y : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) (v : ℂ) : ℂ := ∫ x in {x : ℝ | (ε : ℝ) ≤ |x|}, (Complex.exp (v * (x : ℂ) * I) - 1) * (cgmyLevyDensity C G M Y x : ℂ)

BSM.cgmyTruncatedExponent_decomp.pin: theorem cgmyTruncatedExponent_decomp (C G M Y : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (ε : ℝ≥0) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε ≤ 1) (v : ℝ) : cgmyTruncatedExponent C G M Y ε (v : ℂ) = (∫ x in {x : ℝ | (ε : ℝ) ≤ |x|}, cgmyCompensatedIntegrand v x * (cgmyLevyDensity C G M Y x : ℂ)) + (v : ℂ) * I * ((∫ x in Ioc (ε : ℝ) 1, cgmyDriftIntegrand C G M Y x) : ℂ)

BSM.cgmyTruncatedExponent_integrable.pin: theorem cgmyTruncatedExponent_integrable (C G M Y : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) (hC : 0 < C) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hY : 0 < Y) (hε : 0 < ε) (v : ℝ) : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => (Complex.exp ((v : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * I) - 1) * (cgmyLevyDensity C G M Y x : ℂ)) {x : ℝ | (ε : ℝ) ≤ |x|}

BSM.cgmyTruncatedExponent_tendsto.pin: theorem cgmyTruncatedExponent_tendsto (C G M Y : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (v : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => cgmyTruncatedExponent C G M Y ((2 : ℝ≥0)⁻¹ ^ n) (v : ℂ)) atTop (𝓝 (cgmyLKExponent C G M Y v))

BSM.cgmyTruncatedExponent_zero.pin: theorem cgmyTruncatedExponent_zero (C G M Y : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) : cgmyTruncatedExponent C G M Y ε 0 = 0

BSM.cgmy_cmPriceKernel_integrable.pin: theorem cgmy_cmPriceKernel_integrable (C G M Y τ α : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (hY₁ : Y ≠ 1) (hα : 0 < α) (hMG : α + 1 < M) (hτ : 0 < τ) : Integrable (cmPriceKernel (cgmyCharFactor C G M Y τ) α)

BSM.cgmy_contour_continuous.pin: theorem cgmy_contour_continuous (C G M Y α : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hα : 0 < α) (hY : 0 < Y) (hMG : α + 1 < M) : Continuous fun u : ℝ => cgmyExponent C G M Y (cgmyContour α u)

BSM.cgmy_contour_decay.pin: theorem cgmy_contour_decay (C G M Y τ α : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (hY₁ : Y ≠ 1) (hα : 0 < α) (hMG : α + 1 < M) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) : ∀ u : ℝ, cgmyDecayThreshold C G M Y ≤ |u| → ‖cgmyCharFactor C G M Y τ (cgmyContour α u)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-(τ * cgmyTemperedRate C Y / 2) * |u| ^ Y)

BSM.cgmy_contour_mem_strip.pin: theorem cgmy_contour_mem_strip (G M α : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hα : 0 < α) (hMG : α + 1 < M) : -G < α + 1 ∧ α + 1 < M

BSM.cgmy_cpow_re_ge_of_lt_one.pin: theorem cgmy_cpow_re_ge_of_lt_one {a y Y : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hy : 0 < y) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (hY₁ : Y < 1) : y ^ Y * Real.cos (Real.pi * Y / 2) ≤ (((a : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ (Y : ℂ)).re

BSM.cgmy_cpow_re_le_of_one_le.pin: theorem cgmy_cpow_re_le_of_one_le {a y Y : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hy : 0 < y) (hay : a ≤ y) (hY : 1 ≤ Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) : (((a : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ (Y : ℂ)).re ≤ y ^ Y * Real.cos (Real.pi * Y / 2) + 2 ^ (Y - 1) * Y * a * y ^ (Y - 1)

BSM.cgmy_levy_far_moment.pin: theorem cgmy_levy_far_moment (C M Y u : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hY : 0 < Y) (hu : u < M) : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => C * (Real.exp (-(M - u) * x) * x ^ (-1 - Y))) (Ioi 1)

BSM.cgmy_levy_sq_integrable.pin: theorem cgmy_levy_sq_integrable (C M Y : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hM : 0 < M) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 * (C * (Real.exp (-M * x) * x ^ (-1 - Y)))) (Ioo 0 1)

BSM.cgmy_numeraire_strip.pin: theorem cgmy_numeraire_strip (G M : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 1 < M) : -G < 1 ∧ (1 : ℝ) < M

BSM.cgmy_tempered_prod_neg.pin: theorem cgmy_tempered_prod_neg {Y : ℝ} (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (hY₁ : Y ≠ 1) : Real.Gamma (-Y) * Real.cos (Real.pi * Y / 2) < 0

BSM.cgmy_tempered_rate_neg_eq.pin: theorem cgmy_tempered_rate_neg_eq {C Y : ℝ} (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (hY₁ : Y ≠ 1) : -(cgmyTemperedRate C Y) = 2 * C * Real.Gamma (-Y) * Real.cos (Real.pi * Y / 2)

BSM.charFun_cgmyCpLaw.pin: theorem charFun_cgmyCpLaw (C G M Y : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) (hC : 0 < C) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hY : 0 < Y) (hε : 0 < ε) (τ : ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ) : charFun (cpLaw (τ * (cgmyJumpMeasure C G M Y ε Set.univ).toNNReal) (cgmyJumpLaw C G M Y ε)) t = Complex.exp ((τ : ℂ) * cgmyTruncatedExponent C G M Y ε (t : ℂ))

BSM.charFun_cgmyCpProbability_tendsto.pin: theorem charFun_cgmyCpProbability_tendsto (C G M Y : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (τ : ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => charFun (cgmyCpProbability C G M Y τ ((2 : ℝ≥0)⁻¹ ^ n) hC hG hM hY (pow_pos (inv_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ≥0) < 2)) n) : Measure ℝ) t) atTop (𝓝 (Complex.exp ((τ : ℂ) * cgmyLKExponent C G M Y t)))

BSM.charFun_cgmyLaw.pin: theorem charFun_cgmyLaw (C G M Y : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (τ : ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ) : charFun (cgmyLaw C G M Y τ hC hG hM hY hY₂ : Measure ℝ) t = Complex.exp ((τ : ℂ) * cgmyLKExponent C G M Y t)

BSM.charFun_cgmyLaw_eq_cgmyCharFactor.pin: theorem charFun_cgmyLaw_eq_cgmyCharFactor (C G M Y : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (hY₁ : Y ≠ 1) (τ : ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ) : charFun (cgmyLaw C G M Y τ hC hG hM hY hY₂ : Measure ℝ) t = cgmyCharFactor C G M Y (τ : ℝ) (t : ℂ)

BSM.charFun_convPow.pin: theorem charFun_convPow (ρ : Measure ℝ) (hρ : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ) (t : ℝ) : ∀ n, charFun (convPow ρ n) t = charFun ρ t ^ n | 0 => by rw [convPow, pow_zero, charFun_dirac] simp | n + 1 => by haveI hn : IsFiniteMeasure (convPow ρ n)

BSM.charFun_cpLaw.pin: theorem charFun_cpLaw (lam : ℝ≥0) (ρ : Measure ℝ) (hρ : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ) (t : ℝ) : charFun (cpLaw lam ρ) t = Complex.exp ((lam : ℂ) * (charFun ρ t - 1))

BSM.cmDenom.pin: def cmDenom (α u : ℝ) : ℂ := ↑(α ^ 2 + α - u ^ 2) + ↑((2 * α + 1) * u) * Complex.I

BSM.cmDenom_factor.pin: theorem cmDenom_factor (α u : ℝ) : cmDenom α u = ((α : ℂ) + ↑u * Complex.I) * ((α + 1 : ℂ) + ↑u * Complex.I)

BSM.cmDenom_ne_zero.pin: theorem cmDenom_ne_zero (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (u : ℝ) : cmDenom α u ≠ 0

BSM.cmDenom_u4_le.pin: theorem cmDenom_u4_le (α u : ℝ) : u ^ 4 ≤ (α ^ 2 + α - u ^ 2) ^ 2 + ((2 * α + 1) * u) ^ 2

BSM.cmPriceIntegral.pin: noncomputable def cmPriceIntegral (φ : ℂ → ℂ) (α r tau S k : ℝ) : ℂ := ↑(Real.exp (-r * tau) * S / (2 * Real.pi)) * ∫ u : ℝ, Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ↑(u * k))) * cmPriceKernel φ α u

BSM.cmPriceIntegral_eq_damped_modelFreeC.pin: theorem cmPriceIntegral_eq_damped_modelFreeCall {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {α r tau S k : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hα : 0 < α) {c D Y u₀ : ℝ} {δ : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hY : 0 < Y) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcont : Continuous fun u : ℝ => contourCharFun μ (↑u - ↑(α + 1) * Complex.I)) (hdecay : ∀ u : ℝ, u₀ ≤ |u| → ‖contourCharFun μ (↑u - ↑(α + 1) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ D * Real.exp (-c * |u| ^ Y)) (hTail : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp ((α + 1 + δ) * x)) μ) : cmPriceIntegral (contourCharFun μ) α r tau S k = ↑(dampedModelFreeCall μ S r tau α k)

BSM.cmPriceIntegrand_reflect.pin: theorem cmPriceIntegrand_reflect {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {α k : ℝ} (u : ℝ) : Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ↑((-u) * k))) * cmPriceKernel (contourCharFun μ) α (-u) = conj (Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ↑(u * k))) * cmPriceKernel (contourCharFun μ) α u)

BSM.cmPriceKernel.pin: def cmPriceKernel (φ : ℂ → ℂ) (α u : ℝ) : ℂ := φ (↑u - ↑(α + 1) * Complex.I) * (cmDenom α u)⁻¹

BSM.cmPriceKernel_eq_shift.pin: theorem cmPriceKernel_eq_shift (φ : ℂ → ℂ) (α u : ℝ) : cmPriceKernel φ α u = carrMadanKernel (fun v => φ (v - ↑(2 * α + 1) * Complex.I)) α u

BSM.cmPriceKernel_integrable.pin: theorem cmPriceKernel_integrable {φ : ℂ → ℂ} {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hcont : Continuous fun u : ℝ => φ (↑u - ↑(α + 1) * Complex.I)) {c D Y : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hY : 0 < Y) {u₀ : ℝ} (hdecay : ∀ u : ℝ, u₀ ≤ |u| → ‖φ (↑u - ↑(α + 1) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ D * Real.exp (-c * |u| ^ Y)) : Integrable (cmPriceKernel φ α)

BSM.continuous_dampedModelFreeCall.pin: theorem continuous_dampedModelFreeCall {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {S r tau α : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hα : 0 < α) (hMom : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp ((α + 1) * x)) μ) : Continuous fun k : ℝ => (dampedModelFreeCall μ S r tau α k : ℂ)

BSM.contourCharFun.pin: noncomputable def contourCharFun (μ : Measure ℝ) (v : ℂ) : ℂ := ∫ x, Complex.exp (Complex.I * v * ↑x) ∂μ

BSM.convPow.pin: noncomputable def convPow (ρ : Measure ℝ) : ℕ → Measure ℝ | 0 => Measure.dirac 0 | n + 1 => Measure.conv (convPow ρ n) ρ

BSM.convPow_isFiniteMeasure.pin: theorem convPow_isFiniteMeasure (ρ : Measure ℝ) (hρ : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ) (n : ℕ) : IsFiniteMeasure (convPow ρ n)

BSM.convPow_isProbabilityMeasure.pin: theorem convPow_isProbabilityMeasure (ρ : Measure ℝ) (hρ : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ) : ∀ n, IsProbabilityMeasure (convPow ρ n) | 0 => by rw [convPow]; infer_instance | n + 1 => by rw [convPow] haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure (convPow ρ n)

BSM.cornerEsscherBound_tendsto.pin: theorem cornerEsscherBound_tendsto (σ G M : ℝ) (hGM : 1 < G + M) : Tendsto (fun Y : ℝ => esscherDriftBound (cgmyCornerC σ Y) G M Y) (𝓝[<] (2 : ℝ)) (𝓝 ((σ ^ 2 / 2) * (G + M - 1)))

BSM.cornerEsscherZero_exponent.pin: theorem cornerEsscherZero_exponent (σ G M Y : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 1 < M) (hGM : 1 < G + M) : esscherExponent (cgmyExponent (cgmyCornerC σ Y) G M Y) (esscherThetaZero G M) (-Complex.I) = 0

BSM.cornerEsscherZero_mem.pin: theorem cornerEsscherZero_mem (G M : ℝ) (hGM : 1 < G + M) : esscherThetaZero G M ∈ Ioo (-G) (M - 1)

BSM.cornerEsscherZero_numeraire.pin: theorem cornerEsscherZero_numeraire (σ G M Y τ : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 1 < M) (hGM : 1 < G + M) : cgmyCharFactor (cgmyCornerC σ Y) (G + esscherThetaZero G M) (M - esscherThetaZero G M) Y τ (-Complex.I) = 1

BSM.cornerEsscherZero_tendsto.pin: theorem cornerEsscherZero_tendsto (σ G M : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 1 < M) (hGM : 1 < G + M) (v : ℂ) (hv₁ : -(M - esscherThetaZero G M) < v.im) (hv₂ : v.im < G + esscherThetaZero G M) : Tendsto (fun Y : ℝ => esscherExponent (cgmyExponent (cgmyCornerC σ Y) G M Y) (esscherThetaZero G M) v) (𝓝[<] (2 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (-((σ ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * v ^ 2 - Complex.I * ((σ ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * v))

BSM.cornerForwardExponent.pin: def cornerForwardExponent (σ G M Y r q : ℝ) (v : ℂ) : ℂ := cgmyExponent (cgmyCornerC σ Y) G M Y v + Complex.I * ((r - q - cgmyCumulant (cgmyCornerC σ Y) G M Y 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * v

BSM.cornerForwardExponent_tendsto.pin: theorem cornerForwardExponent_tendsto (σ G M r q : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 1 < M) (v : ℂ) (hv₁ : -M < v.im) (hv₂ : v.im < G) : Tendsto (fun Y : ℝ => cornerForwardExponent σ G M Y r q v) (𝓝[<] (2 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (Complex.I * ((r - q - σ ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * v - ((σ ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * v ^ 2))

BSM.cornerForwardFactor_numeraire.pin: theorem cornerForwardFactor_numeraire (σ G M Y τ r q : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 1 < M) : Complex.exp ((τ : ℂ) * cornerForwardExponent σ G M Y r q (-Complex.I)) = Complex.exp ((τ : ℂ) * ((r - q : ℝ) : ℂ))

BSM.cornerForwardFactor_tendsto.pin: theorem cornerForwardFactor_tendsto (σ G M τ r q : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 1 < M) (v : ℂ) (hv₁ : -M < v.im) (hv₂ : v.im < G) : Tendsto (fun Y : ℝ => Complex.exp ((τ : ℂ) * cornerForwardExponent σ G M Y r q v)) (𝓝[<] (2 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (gbmCharFactor ((r - q - σ ^ 2 / 2) * τ) ((σ ^ 2 / 2) * τ) v))

BSM.cpLaw.pin: noncomputable def cpLaw (lam : ℝ≥0) (ρ : Measure ℝ) : Measure ℝ := Measure.sum (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (poissonPMFReal lam n) • convPow ρ n)

BSM.d1.pin: def d1 (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) : ℝ := (Real.log (S / K) + (r - q + sigma ^ 2 / 2) * tau) / (sigma * Real.sqrt tau)

BSM.d1_exponent.pin: theorem d1_exponent (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : sigma * Real.sqrt tau * d1 S K tau r q sigma - (sigma * Real.sqrt tau) ^ 2 / 2 = Real.log (S / K) + (r - q) * tau

BSM.d1_tau_sub_d2_tau.pin: theorem d1_tau_sub_d2_tau (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : (r - q + sigma ^ 2 / 2 - Real.log (S / K) / tau) / (2 * sigma * Real.sqrt tau) - (r - q - sigma ^ 2 / 2 - Real.log (S / K) / tau) / (2 * sigma * Real.sqrt tau) = sigma / (2 * Real.sqrt tau)

BSM.d2.pin: def d2 (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) : ℝ := (Real.log (S / K) + (r - q - sigma ^ 2 / 2) * tau) / (sigma * Real.sqrt tau)

BSM.d2_exponent.pin: theorem d2_exponent (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : sigma * Real.sqrt tau * d2 S K tau r q sigma + (sigma * Real.sqrt tau) ^ 2 / 2 = Real.log (S / K) + (r - q) * tau

BSM.d_tau_quotient_eq.pin: theorem d_tau_quotient_eq (A c sigma s tau : ℝ) (hs : s ^ 2 = tau) (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : (c * (sigma * s) - (A + c * tau) * (sigma * (1 / (2 * s)))) / (sigma * s) ^ 2 = (c - A / tau) / (2 * sigma * s)

BSM.dampedCallPrice.pin: def dampedCallPrice (S : ℝ) (v : NNReal) (m r tau alpha : ℝ) (k : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (alpha * k) * (Real.exp (-r * tau) * ∫ x, max (S * Real.exp x - S * Real.exp k) 0 ∂(ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal m v))

BSM.dampedCallPrice_log_eq.pin: theorem dampedCallPrice_log_eq (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) (v : NNReal) (hv : (v : ℝ) = sigma ^ 2 * tau) (alpha : ℝ) : dampedCallPrice S v ((r - q - sigma ^ 2 / 2) * tau) r tau alpha (Real.log (K / S)) = Real.exp (alpha * Real.log (K / S)) * bsCall S K tau r q sigma

BSM.dampedModelFreeCall.pin: noncomputable def dampedModelFreeCall (μ : Measure ℝ) (S r tau α k : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (α * k) * (Real.exp (-r * tau) * ∫ x, max (S * Real.exp x - S * Real.exp k) 0 ∂μ)

BSM.dampedModelFreeCall_eq_dampedCallPri.pin: theorem dampedModelFreeCall_eq_dampedCallPrice {S m r tau α k : ℝ} {v : NNReal} : dampedModelFreeCall (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal m v) S r tau α k = dampedCallPrice S v m r tau α k

BSM.esscherDriftBound.pin: def esscherDriftBound (C G M Y : ℝ) : ℝ := |C * Real.Gamma (-Y)| * |(G + M) ^ Y - (G + M - 1) ^ Y - 1|

BSM.esscherDriftBound_pos.pin: theorem esscherDriftBound_pos (C G M Y : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (hY₁ : Y ≠ 1) (hGM : 1 < G + M) : 0 < esscherDriftBound C G M Y

BSM.esscherDriftMap.pin: def esscherDriftMap (C G M Y θ : ℝ) : ℝ := cgmyCumulant C G M Y (θ + 1) - cgmyCumulant C G M Y θ

BSM.esscherDriftMap_bound_eq.pin: theorem esscherDriftMap_bound_eq (C G M Y : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (hY₁ : Y ≠ 1) (hGM : 1 < G + M) : esscherDriftMap C G M Y (-G) = - esscherDriftBound C G M Y ∧ esscherDriftMap C G M Y (M - 1) = esscherDriftBound C G M Y

BSM.esscherDriftMap_mem_range.pin: theorem esscherDriftMap_mem_range (C G M Y θ : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (hY₁ : Y ≠ 1) (hGM : 1 < G + M) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (-G) (M - 1)) : - esscherDriftBound C G M Y < esscherDriftMap C G M Y θ ∧ esscherDriftMap C G M Y θ < esscherDriftBound C G M Y

BSM.esscherDriftMap_reflect.pin: theorem esscherDriftMap_reflect (C G M Y θ : ℝ) : esscherDriftMap C G M Y (M - G - 1 - θ) = - esscherDriftMap C G M Y θ

BSM.esscherDriftMap_strictMono.pin: theorem esscherDriftMap_strictMono (C G M Y : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hY : 0 < Y) (hY₂ : Y < 2) (hY₁ : Y ≠ 1) : StrictMonoOn (esscherDriftMap C G M Y) (Icc (-G) (M - 1))

BSM.esscherDriftMap_zero.pin: theorem esscherDriftMap_zero (C G M Y : ℝ) : esscherDriftMap C G M Y (esscherThetaZero G M) = 0

BSM.esscherExponent.pin: def esscherExponent (ψ : ℂ → ℂ) (θ : ℝ) (v : ℂ) : ℂ := ψ (v - (θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - ψ (-(θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)

BSM.esscherExponent_neg_I_eq.pin: theorem esscherExponent_neg_I_eq (C G M Y θ : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (-G) (M - 1)) : esscherExponent (cgmyExponent C G M Y) θ (-Complex.I) = ((esscherDriftMap C G M Y θ : ℝ) : ℂ)

BSM.pareto_no_drift_makes_spot_integrabl.pin: theorem pareto_no_drift_makes_spot_integrable {t r : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hr : 0 < r) (S₀ d : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S₀) : ¬ Integrable (fun x => S₀ * Real.exp (x + d)) (paretoMeasure t r)

BSM.phi_eq_gaussianPDFReal.pin: theorem phi_eq_gaussianPDFReal (x : ℝ) : phi x = ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x

BSM.phi_neg.pin: theorem phi_neg (x : ℝ) : phi (-x) = phi x

BSM.sigma_sqrt_tau_mul_d2.pin: theorem sigma_sqrt_tau_mul_d2 (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : sigma * Real.sqrt tau * d2 S K tau r q sigma = Real.log (S / K) + (r - q - sigma ^ 2 / 2) * tau

BSM.spot_not_integrable_of_tail_lower_bo.pin: theorem spot_not_integrable_of_tail_lower_bound (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (α c x₀ S₀ : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S₀) (hc : 0 < c) (htail : ∀ x ≥ x₀, ENNReal.ofReal (c * x ^ (-α)) ≤ μ (Set.Ici x)) : ¬ Integrable (fun x => S₀ * Real.exp x) μ

BSM.static_skeleton_does_not_select_meas.pin: theorem static_skeleton_does_not_select_measure : IsProbabilityMeasure witnessMeasureA ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure witnessMeasureB ∧ witnessMeasureA ≠ witnessMeasureB ∧ (witnessMeasureA ≪ witnessMeasureB ∧ witnessMeasureB ≪ witnessMeasureA) ∧ (∫ s, id s ∂witnessMeasureA = 1 * Real.exp ((0 - 0) * 1)) ∧ (∫ s, id s ∂witnessMeasureB = 1 * Real.exp ((0 - 0) * 1)) ∧ (modelFreeCall witnessMeasureA id 1 0 1 - modelFreePut witnessMeasureA id 1 0 1 = 1 * Real.exp (-0 * 1) - 1 * Real.exp (-0 * 1)) ∧ (modelFreeCall witnessMeasureB id 1 0 1 - modelFreePut witnessMeasureB id 1 0 1 = 1 * Real.exp (-0 * 1) - 1 * Real.exp (-0 * 1)) ∧ (max (1 * Real.exp (-0 * 1) - 1 * Real.exp (-0 * 1)) 0 ≤ modelFreeCall witnessMeasureA id 1 0 1 ∧ modelFreeCall witnessMeasureA id 1 0 1 ≤ 1 * Real.exp (-0 * 1)) ∧ (max (1 * Real.exp (-0 * 1) - 1 * Real.exp (-0 * 1)) 0 ≤ modelFreeCall witnessMeasureB id 1 0 1 ∧ modelFreeCall witnessMeasureB id 1 0 1 ≤ 1 * Real.exp (-0 * 1)) ∧ modelFreeCall witnessMeasureA id 1 0 1 ≠ modelFreeCall witnessMeasureB id 1 0 1

BSM.strikeTransform.pin: noncomputable def strikeTransform (S α x u : ℝ) : ℂ := ∫ k : ℝ, Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑(u * k)) * ↑(Real.exp (α * k)) * ↑(max (S * Real.exp x - S * Real.exp k) 0)

BSM.strikeTransform_eq.pin: theorem strikeTransform_eq {S x u α : ℝ} (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hα : 0 < α) : strikeTransform S α x u = ↑(S * Real.exp (x * (α + 1))) * Complex.exp (↑(x * u) * Complex.I) * (cmDenom α u)⁻¹

BSM.t1_d1_minus_d2.pin: theorem t1_d1_minus_d2 (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : d1 S K tau r q sigma - d2 S K tau r q sigma = sigma * Real.sqrt tau

BSM.t2_put_call_parity.pin: theorem t2_put_call_parity (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) : bsPut S K tau r q sigma = bsCall S K tau r q sigma - S * Real.exp (-q * tau) + K * Real.exp (-r * tau)

BSM.t2_put_call_parity_spread.pin: theorem t2_put_call_parity_spread (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) : bsCall S K tau r q sigma - bsPut S K tau r q sigma = S * Real.exp (-q * tau) - K * Real.exp (-r * tau)

BSM.t2_spread_via_skeleton.pin: theorem t2_spread_via_skeleton (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) : bsCall S K tau r q sigma - bsPut S K tau r q sigma = S * Real.exp (-q * tau) - K * Real.exp (-r * tau)

BSM.t3_delta_identity.pin: theorem t3_delta_identity (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : S * Real.exp (-q * tau) * phi (d1 S K tau r q sigma) = K * Real.exp (-r * tau) * phi (d2 S K tau r q sigma)

BSM.t4_call_bounds.pin: theorem t4_call_bounds (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) : max (S * Real.exp (-q * tau) - K * Real.exp (-r * tau)) 0 ≤ bsCall S K tau r q sigma ∧ bsCall S K tau r q sigma ≤ S * Real.exp (-q * tau)

BSM.t4_call_bounds_via_skeleton.pin: theorem t4_call_bounds_via_skeleton (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) : max (S * Real.exp (-q * tau) - K * Real.exp (-r * tau)) 0 ≤ bsCall S K tau r q sigma ∧ bsCall S K tau r q sigma ≤ S * Real.exp (-q * tau)

BSM.t4_put_bounds.pin: theorem t4_put_bounds (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) : max (K * Real.exp (-r * tau) - S * Real.exp (-q * tau)) 0 ≤ bsPut S K tau r q sigma ∧ bsPut S K tau r q sigma ≤ K * Real.exp (-r * tau)

BSM.t5_bsCall_pde.pin: theorem t5_bsCall_pde (S K T t r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (hTt : 0 < T - t) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : deriv (fun u => bsCall S K (T - u) r q sigma) t + (r - q) * S * deriv (fun x => bsCall x K (T - t) r q sigma) S + (sigma ^ 2 / 2) * S ^ 2 * deriv (fun x => deriv (fun y => bsCall y K (T - t) r q sigma) x) S = r * bsCall S K (T - t) r q sigma

BSM.t5_bsCall_pde_tau.pin: theorem t5_bsCall_pde_tau (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : -deriv (fun u => bsCall S K u r q sigma) tau + (r - q) * S * deriv (fun x => bsCall x K tau r q sigma) S + (sigma ^ 2 / 2) * S ^ 2 * deriv (fun x => deriv (fun y => bsCall y K tau r q sigma) x) S = r * bsCall S K tau r q sigma

BSM.t5_delta.pin: theorem t5_delta (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : deriv (fun x => bsCall x K tau r q sigma) S = Real.exp (-q * tau) * Phi (d1 S K tau r q sigma)

BSM.t5_gamma.pin: theorem t5_gamma (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : deriv (fun x => deriv (fun y => bsCall y K tau r q sigma) x) S = Real.exp (-q * tau) * phi (d1 S K tau r q sigma) / (S * sigma * Real.sqrt tau)

BSM.t5_tau.pin: theorem t5_tau (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun u => bsCall S K u r q sigma) (-q * (S * Real.exp (-q * tau) * Phi (d1 S K tau r q sigma)) + r * (K * Real.exp (-r * tau) * Phi (d2 S K tau r q sigma)) + (sigma / (2 * Real.sqrt tau)) * (S * Real.exp (-q * tau) * phi (d1 S K tau r q sigma))) tau

BSM.trinomialMeasure.pin: noncomputable def trinomialMeasure (p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃ : ℝ) : Measure ℝ := ENNReal.ofReal p₁ • Measure.dirac s₁ + ENNReal.ofReal p₂ • Measure.dirac s₂ + ENNReal.ofReal p₃ • Measure.dirac s₃

BSM.trinomialMeasure_absolutelyContinuou.pin: theorem trinomialMeasure_absolutelyContinuous_of_pos (q₁ q₂ q₃ p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃ : ℝ) (h₁ : 0 < p₁) (h₂ : 0 < p₂) (h₃ : 0 < p₃) : trinomialMeasure q₁ q₂ q₃ s₁ s₂ s₃ ≪ trinomialMeasure p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃

BSM.trinomialMeasure_ae_of_atoms.pin: theorem trinomialMeasure_ae_of_atoms {P : ℝ → Prop} (p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃ : ℝ) (h₁ : P s₁) (h₂ : P s₂) (h₃ : P s₃) : ∀ᵐ s ∂(trinomialMeasure p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃), P s

BSM.trinomialMeasure_apply.pin: theorem trinomialMeasure_apply (p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃ : ℝ) (A : Set ℝ) : trinomialMeasure p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃ A = ENNReal.ofReal p₁ * Measure.dirac s₁ A + ENNReal.ofReal p₂ * Measure.dirac s₂ A + ENNReal.ofReal p₃ * Measure.dirac s₃ A

BSM.trinomialMeasure_integrable.pin: theorem trinomialMeasure_integrable (f : ℝ → ℝ) (p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃ : ℝ) : Integrable f (trinomialMeasure p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃)

BSM.trinomialMeasure_integral.pin: theorem trinomialMeasure_integral (f : ℝ → ℝ) (p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃ : ℝ) (h₁ : 0 ≤ p₁) (h₂ : 0 ≤ p₂) (h₃ : 0 ≤ p₃) : ∫ s, f s ∂(trinomialMeasure p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃) = p₁ * f s₁ + p₂ * f s₂ + p₃ * f s₃

BSM.trinomialMeasure_isProbability.pin: theorem trinomialMeasure_isProbability (p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃ : ℝ) (h₁ : 0 ≤ p₁) (h₂ : 0 ≤ p₂) (h₃ : 0 ≤ p₃) (hsum : p₁ + p₂ + p₃ = 1) : IsProbabilityMeasure (trinomialMeasure p₁ p₂ p₃ s₁ s₂ s₃)

BSM.trinomial_witness_drift.pin: theorem trinomial_witness_drift (p₁ p₂ p₃ : ℝ) (h₁ : 0 ≤ p₁) (h₂ : 0 ≤ p₂) (h₃ : 0 ≤ p₃) : ∫ s, id s ∂(trinomialMeasure p₁ p₂ p₃ witnessSpotLo witnessSpotMid witnessSpotHi) = p₁ / 2 + p₂ + 2 * p₃

BSM.undamped_dampedCallPrice.pin: theorem undamped_dampedCallPrice (S K tau r q sigma : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (htau : 0 < tau) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) (v : NNReal) (hv : (v : ℝ) = sigma ^ 2 * tau) (alpha : ℝ) : Real.exp (-alpha * Real.log (K / S)) * dampedCallPrice S v ((r - q - sigma ^ 2 / 2) * tau) r tau alpha (Real.log (K / S)) = bsCall S K tau r q sigma

BSM.vgCornerExponent.pin: noncomputable def vgCornerExponent (C G M : ℝ) (v : ℂ) : ℂ := (C : ℂ) * (Complex.log ((M : ℂ) / ((M : ℂ) - Complex.I * v)) + Complex.log ((G : ℂ) / ((G : ℂ) + Complex.I * v)))

BSM.vgCumulant.pin: noncomputable def vgCumulant (C G M u : ℝ) : ℝ := C * (Real.log (M / (M - u)) + Real.log (G / (G + u)))

BSM.vgCumulant_eq_corner_re.pin: theorem vgCumulant_eq_corner_re (C G M u : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (h₁ : -G < u) (h₂ : u < M) : vgCumulant C G M u = (vgCornerExponent C G M (-(u : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re

BSM.vgCumulant_hasDerivAt.pin: theorem vgCumulant_hasDerivAt (C G M u : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (h₁ : -G < u) (h₂ : u < M) : HasDerivAt (vgCumulant C G M) (C * (1 / (M - u) - 1 / (G + u))) u

BSM.vgTilt_isProbabilityMeasure.pin: theorem vgTilt_isProbabilityMeasure (C G M τ θ : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (-G) (M - 1)) : IsProbabilityMeasure (vgTilt C G M τ θ)

BSM.vg_drift_identity.pin: theorem vg_drift_identity (C G M τ θ S r q : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (-G) (M - 1)) (hdrift : vgDriftMap C G M θ = r - q) : ∫ x, S * Real.exp x ∂(vgTilt C G M τ θ) = S * Real.exp ((r - q) * τ)

BSM.vg_modelFree_call_bounds.pin: theorem vg_modelFree_call_bounds (C G M τ θ S K r q : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (-G) (M - 1)) (hdrift : vgDriftMap C G M θ = r - q) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hS : 0 ≤ S) : max (S * Real.exp (-q * τ) - K * Real.exp (-r * τ)) 0 ≤ modelFreeCall (vgTilt C G M τ θ) (fun x => S * Real.exp x) K r τ ∧ modelFreeCall (vgTilt C G M τ θ) (fun x => S * Real.exp x) K r τ ≤ S * Real.exp (-q * τ)

BSM.vg_modelFree_parity.pin: theorem vg_modelFree_parity (C G M τ θ S K r q : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (-G) (M - 1)) (hdrift : vgDriftMap C G M θ = r - q) : modelFreeCall (vgTilt C G M τ θ) (fun x => S * Real.exp x) K r τ - modelFreePut (vgTilt C G M τ θ) (fun x => S * Real.exp x) K r τ = S * Real.exp (-q * τ) - K * Real.exp (-r * τ)

BSM.vg_modelFree_put_bounds.pin: theorem vg_modelFree_put_bounds (C G M τ θ S K r q : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (-G) (M - 1)) (hdrift : vgDriftMap C G M θ = r - q) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hS : 0 ≤ S) : max (K * Real.exp (-r * τ) - S * Real.exp (-q * τ)) 0 ≤ modelFreePut (vgTilt C G M τ θ) (fun x => S * Real.exp x) K r τ ∧ modelFreePut (vgTilt C G M τ θ) (fun x => S * Real.exp x) K r τ ≤ K * Real.exp (-r * τ)

BSM.vg_tilt_cumulant_shift.pin: theorem vg_tilt_cumulant_shift (C G M θ u : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hθlo : -G < θ) (hθhi : θ < M) (hu₁ : -(G + θ) < u) (hu₂ : u < M - θ) : vgCumulant C G M (u + θ) - vgCumulant C G M θ = vgCumulant C (G + θ) (M - θ) u
